title: Xưng hô: addressing people by age and gender

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say hello —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: xin chào] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say thank you —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cảm ơn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say the polite opener —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dạ] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Xin chào anh!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, xin chào chị!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Xin chào em!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, xin chào anh!] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: You just heard three new words for addressing people.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: First,] [VI: anh] [EN: it means you, for an older man. It has] [VI: ngang] [EN: — flat, no mark. Listen again.] [VI_F: anh] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: anh] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: anh] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: chị] [EN: it means you, for an older woman. It has] [VI: dấu nặng] [EN: — low, cut off. Listen again.] [VI_F: chị] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: chị] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chị] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Last,] [VI: em] [EN: it means you, for someone younger. It has] [VI: ngang] [EN: — flat. Listen again.] [VI_F: em] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: em] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: em] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Add any of them to] [VI: xin chào] [EN: to greet someone by their age and gender.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào chị.]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Older man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: anh] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Older woman —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chị] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Younger person —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: em] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. Older man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: anh] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Older woman —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chị] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Younger person —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: em] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One more round.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Older man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: anh] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Older woman —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chị] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Younger person —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: em] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now say hello to each of them.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Hello to an older man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào anh.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Hello to an older woman —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào chị.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Hello to someone younger —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào em.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: anh] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: an older man] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: chị] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: an older woman] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: em] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: someone younger] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: anh] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: chị] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: em] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: chị] [EN: has] [VI: dấu nặng] [EN: — low and cut off.]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Xin chào anh!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, xin chào chị!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Xin chào em!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, xin chào anh!] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. Greet an older woman politely.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, xin chào chị.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next lesson, you will learn to count and ask a price. One word to start —] [VI: bao nhiêu] [EN: it means how much. See you then.]
